text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was about half a month before Admire 
Vega was set to run in the Hopeful 
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Hanshin in winter, a Make Debut in the 
rain! The 1st favorite, Narita Top Road, 
falls short by a neck to finish in 2nd 
place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... Top Road-san, that was so 
clooose...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, in terms of condition, she looked 
head and shoulders above the rest in the 
paddock and all... Guess she just fell a 
bit short, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's okay! It'll be fine!! Top 
Road-san, you've been working so seriously 
and hard every single day... That's why 
you'll win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Thank you so much for your 
support!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for such a disappointing 
result this time! But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Next time! I'll do my absolute best to 
show you great results, I promise!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to support me—thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... Top Road-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely, definitely come cheer 
for you next time tooooo!! So... do your 
beeeeeeest!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Right. Next time for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time, for sure...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the day of the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between her mother's honors, her own 
innate talent, and a stellar performance 
in her debut race, Admire Vega's 
popularity was soaring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cheers still roared even all the way 
in the waiting room, and it was no 
exaggeration to say that most of them were 
directed at Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, as for the person in question—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the entry sheet. ...Show it to 
me, I want to check it one last time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like after her debut race, she didn't 
seem particularly bothered, acting 
completely as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having chosen isolation to dedicate 
herself entirely to her mission— 
dedicating her victories to her little 
sister— she remained virtually untouched 
by outside influences.
choice_data_list:
(I guess you could call it a strength, 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I was pondering that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I'm Narita Top Road, pardon the 
intrusion!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, do you have a moment right now? I'm 
sorry if you're in the middle of a 
meeting.
choice_data_list: I'm fine. Did you come to cheer me on?
It's okay, did you come to cheer me on?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Because today is an important 
race for Ayabe-san."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You have a race tomorrow too, don't 
you? Shouldn't you be spending your time 
on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, no, you see, in my debut 
race the other day, I ended up falling 
just a bit short.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Watching a classmate's race and getting 
fired up again!" Kind of like that, I 
guess... I had those feelings too. So, I 
came here for myself as well!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see. If so, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. ...Still, Ayabe-san is truly 
amazing, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it? Monthly Twinkle's 
'Pre-Race Popularity Poll'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Narita Top Road is referring to is 
one of the regular features run by the 
popular Umamusume racing magazine, 
"Monthly Twinkle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prior to major races, online polls and 
expert opinions are gathered and announced 
as the 'Pre-Race Popularity Ratings'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While it differs from the popularity seen 
on race day, this project has earned solid 
acclaim as a benchmark for gauging the 
competitors' true abilities.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Just like in her debut race, Ayabe-san is 
the number one favorite here at the 
Hopeful Stakes, even amidst such a stacked 
field of Junior Class contenders...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think you're incredible. Just walking a 
bit through the stands, I could hear your 
name everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone... has really high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, u... um, well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Like... being scared that you might not be 
able to live up to it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, I'm sorry!! Ahaha, what on earth 
am I saying?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What needs to be done hasn't changed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens around her. No 
matter how difficult, painful, 
disadvantageous, reckless, or 
inexperienced she might be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will shoulder what I chose to bear. I 
will see through what I set my mind to.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I believe that…… is what they call 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Resolve...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And true resolve is forged precisely in 
solitude.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...For instance, only out on that turf, 
where you have no choice but to push 
forward on your own legs, does it become 
an unshakable strength.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's just how things are—at least, 
that's what I think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Ayabe-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Admire Vega left the waiting 
room."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With strides bearing unwavering resolve... 
toward the stage of a solitary battle, the 
Hopeful Stakes.
